identification: Four pieces of mid-century Italian (Murano-style) art glass, 2 as is: (1) green sommerso fish-and-vase on green foot with silver/gold aventurine fish and clear applied rigaree, (2) green cased jack-in-the-pulpit/cornucopia vase with clear twisted tail, (3) aqua heavy-walled free-form ruffled vase on clear twist base (Murano/Seguso style), (4) purple/amber pheasant bird with long amber tail on faceted clear base (tail tip appears chipped, likely the 'as is').
